purpose: Integrate leakage-safe raw match serve/return statistics from Kaggle Tennis 2011-2019 into private canonical history.
source_policy: Only raw current-match Aces, Double Faults, serve, return and break-point-return counts/rates are imported. *_A, *_L5, *_CUR result/model features and *_picks.csv are forbidden.
feature_policy: Historical match observations only; same-match values update state after point-in-time feature snapshot.
retry_reason: Final production write requested after prior dry-run success and data-writer queue is clear.
